title: The biggest IPO in history

lines: Anthropic's price tag in the biggest IPO ever.
The maker of the Claude AI priced its stock at $83 a share.
It raised about $81.3 billion — a record.
It starts trading today on the Nasdaq as ANT.
The biggest stock-market debut in history.
This sets the price on the AI boom that's lifted your index funds and 401(k) all year.
A number this big measures expectations, not earnings — the market now leans on a few AI names.
Would you buy the AI boom at a $1.5 trillion price?

caption:
The maker of the Claude AI just pulled off the biggest IPO in history.

Anthropic priced its stock at $83 a share and raised about $81.3 billion, valuing the company at $1.5 trillion — a record (Yahoo Finance, AP, Nov. 19). It begins trading today on the Nasdaq under the ticker ANT.

Why it matters even if you never buy a share: this puts a hard price tag on the AI boom that's driven index funds and 401(k)s all year. A $1.5 trillion debut is a bet on future profits, not a reward for past ones.

My take: a number this big measures expectations, not earnings — and it shows how much of the market now rides on a handful of AI names.

Would you buy a slice of the AI boom at a $1.5 trillion price? 👇
